The Watchers are the jailers and marshals of night elf society. They guard the barrow-prisons of the night elves and hunt down dangerous criminals. Though their members came from a number of backgrounds, their original members were volunteers of the Sisterhood of Elune. A circular blade called an :Umbra Crescent is the favored weapon of the Watchers, most famously wielded by Maiev Shadowsong, but can be seen even today on night elves such as the Barrow Deeps Watchers on Mount Hyjal. They can also wield typical glaives. The highest rank that can be bestowed on a Watcher is the one of Warden.

The Wastewander (or Wastewanders and Wastewander Bandits) are a group of humans who inhabit the deserts of Tanaris and Uldum. They are currently led by Arik Scorpidsting, and were formerly led by Caliph Scorpidsting when they were a gang of bandits. As their name implies, the group was formerly nomadic; wandering around Tanaris and later Uldum. This shifted by the time of the Assault in Uldum, where the Wastewanders were shown to have established several settlements in abandoned tol'vir ruins and encampments left behind by Schnottz's crew; complete with trade caravans and a port.

Waryk was a lieutenant under the command of Major Remka. He was the leader of the group that captured Thrall and put him in an internment camp. He reprimanded Hult for trying to steal a knife in Thrall's posession and questioned Thrall as to whether he could read. Waryk himself was unable to read and write, but dreamed of being able to one day, leading his cohorts to tease him for "dreaming above his station". He was significantly kinder and gentler towards the orcs than other guards. Waryk had evidently seen Thrall's gladiator duels, as he thought Thrall looked familiar, but was unable to recall where he had seen him before. He was later promoted, replacing the newly demoted Lieutenant Remk

Wasteland Calves are yaks located at Mazu's Overlook and Stinging Trail in Dread Wastes.
Wasteland Yaks are yaks located at Mazu's Overlook and Stinging Trail in Dread Wastes.
Watchers of Death is located in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Watcher Vesperbloom is a faerie located at the Heart of the Forest in Ardenweald.
__NOTOC__ Wary Sentries are dwarves and draenei located at Arom's Stand in Drustvar during the Faction Assault on Drustvar. They have the Keen Eyes buff, allowing them to detect stealth.
Watchmaster Dorum is a Maldraxxi gladiator located at the House of the Chosen in Maldraxxus.
Wartusk is a bloodtusk located just outside the Spire of War in Maldraxxus. It is the mount of Warbringer Mal'Korak.
Watcher Havros is a kyrian located at Perdition Hold in the Maw. Attempting to free him will send his soul into the :Soulkeeper Crystal. He will respawn almost immediately however.
Wary Survivors are stealthed aranakk located throughout Akarek's Tears in Maldraxxus during Whisper of Hope. __NOTOC__

__NOTOC__ Wastes Scavengers are ghouls located at Galakrond's Rest in the Dragonblight. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, they attacked Galford at Wicked Coil and Dragon Wastes, but the paladin killed them.
Watcher Jacintha is a kyrian located in the Temple of Humility in Bastion during Limbo (quest).
The Watchful Eye of the Damned drops from the Towering Exterminator in Korthia.
Water-Run Letters are looted from Stoneborn Satchels located throughout Revendreth.
Watchful Arbelist's Bracers drops from elite mobs in Castle Nathria.
Watchers of Flame are core hounds that were to take part in the Portal Keeper Hasabel encounter in Antorus, the Burning Throne.
Watch the Shoes! is a soulbind trait available on row 3 of Theotar the Mad Duke's soulbind tree. It causes Door of Shadows to clear root and snare effects from you.
Wastewarped Deathwalker is an achievement reward from Shadowlands Keystone Master: Season Three.
__NOTOC__ Watcher Fero is a high elf found in the Library of the Hall of Explorers of Ironforge.

Watcher Koranos is a titanic watcher located on the Dragon Isles. As the last survivor of the group that was charged with watching its shorelines, he was the one who reactivated the Beacon of Tyrhold. Though willing to sacrifice himself for the task, he was saved by Alexstrasza, who had come in response to the beacon's reactivation. Having been around when the Isles were the pinnacle of the dragons' kingdom, he has a special place within their hearts.

Warug's Target Dummy is an advanced target dummy deployed by Warug at his camp outside Magram Village in Desolace upon completion of Gizmo for Warug. It persists for a few seconds, making Warug laugh, before it expires. Somewhat oddly, it is considered part of the Gelkis Clan Centaur faction, meaning it appears as to anyone doing the quest (since the quest requires the player to be affiliated with the Magram Clan Centaur).

Watchful Drakes are velocidrakes standing on four different spots along the cliffs of the Ohn'ahran Plains' northern coast, between the Emerald Gardens in the west and Khalla and Tuktu's grill in the east. They can spawn with either green, bronze, or red appearances.
Watcher's 'Neck' Ring drops from the Overloading Defense Matrix in Thaldraszus.
Watchman's Flare is available for purchase from the Trading Post for 100 Trader's Tender. It was first available in April 2023.

Water Ascendants are elemental ascendant located in Abyssal Depths.
Washed Up Cargo is found at the Wailing Tideway in Tiragarde Sound.
The Watchman's Tower is a scout tower located at Watchman's Rise in Drustvar.

Watcher of the Huntress is an owl companion that has not been released.
Watcher's Lightning Rod drops from Tempestrian in Thaldraszus and Shardwing in the Primalist Future.
Water-Ordained Signet is a quest reward from Aiding Azure Span.
Wasp Repelling Skullcap is a quest reward from Leave Bee Alone.
Watcher's Clasp of Purpose drops from Watcher Irideus in Halls of Infusion.
Water-Infused Shell drops from Soggymaw Crabtrapper, Soggymaw Wavebringer and Soggymaw Seabasher in the Waking Shores.

__NOTOC__ Watcher Du'una is a jungle troll that guarded the The Purple Princess from Alliance members from coming aboard the zeppelin that ran between Brill in Tirisfal Glades and Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

Watcher Umjin is a jungle troll that guarded The Purple Princess from Alliance members who would try to board the zeppelin which ran between Brill in Tirisfal Glades and Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn. He was given the post by Cableclamp as a favor to his family. He could be usually found sleeping on the job, unless when he's being yelled at.

Water Walking is a shaman utility spell that gives a buff to friendly targets which allows them to walk on water. A player under the effects of Water Walking can still dive under water if they choose, and doing so will not cancel the buff.
